formula.ascii: distances start at 0xffffffff; seeds get 0. In round k each frontier vertex u with distances[u] = k lowers distances[v] to k+1 (atomicMin) for every neighbor v, and predecessors[v] = min(predecessors[v], u) among the parents that offered distance k+1. A vertex whose previous distance was 0xffffffff joins the next compact frontier. Overflow in the chosen adjacency leaves everything unreachable.
